about: Names people search for that a station page does not carry (docs/DECISIONS.md 0032). Each entry is pinned to the station's display name; when that changes, the entry stops applying and tests/test_site.py fails. 'name' leads the page's title and H1, place first. 'query' is a Search Console query that shows the name is searched for (28 days to 2026-11-11 for the first five entries, 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-13 for the rest); 'basis' is what ties the name to the station.
